training_data.name: medrescue
training_data.quote: The model was trained on ericrisco/medrescue, a comprehensive medical dataset containing: 86,667 medical Q&A pairs from multiple authoritative sources; 11 specialized medical datasets covering clinical reasoning, symptoms, medications; 14 official medical PDFs from WHO, ICRC, military, and government sources; RAG-enhanced content using vector search and AI generation.

training_method.update_scope_quote: Fine-tuning Method: LoRA (r=8, alpha=8, dropout=0). Quantization: 4-bit loading for memory efficiency. load_in_4bit=True, full_finetuning=False.

description.text: Medical Gemma-3N is a specialized version of Google's Gemma-3N-4B model, fine-tuned specifically for emergency medical assistance and offline healthcare applications. This model is designed to provide accurate medical guidance in emergency scenarios where internet connectivity may be limited or unavailable.

serving.notes: generation_config.json sets do_sample, top_k 64, and top_p 0.95. The card example adds temperature 0.7 and max_new_tokens 512. Training max sequence length is 1024. config.json is Gemma3n with vision and audio blocks; the published example is text only, and the training notebook sets finetune_vision_layers=False. tokenizer_config sets use_default_system_prompt false. This repository has no adapter_config.json; the card calls it the full merged model. The GitHub Ollama Modelfile for the GGUF sibling includes a system string that is not in this repository.

evaluation_reported.text: On lextale/FirstAidInstructionsDataset, an AI judge scored Medical Gemma-3N at 71.54% (93/130) and the base Gemma-3N at 36.15% (47/130).

discrepancies: Inventory methods is lora. The card names LoRA (r=8, alpha=8) and 4-bit loading. The training notebook loads the base with load_in_4bit=True and full_finetuning=False, so the update is QLoRA. Dataset ericrisco/medrescue and parent unsloth/gemma-3n-E4B-it match. No source names a training objective.
